title: Bar Juice 5000 Blackberry Raspberry 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Blackberry Raspberry from Bar Juice 5000 brings together two vibrant berry notes for a rich, fruit-driven vape. Deep, juicy Blackberry sets the tone with its naturally dark sweetness, while Raspberry cuts through with a lively, tangy lift. Together, the flavours create a rounded berry profile with plenty of depth and clarity. A cool Ice layer completes the blend with a crisp, refreshing exhale. Blended with nicotine salts for quick satisfaction and a comfortable throat feel, this e-liquid performs best in MTL (mouth-to-lung) devices such as refillable pod kits and beginner starter kits . Available in 5mg, 10mg and 20mg strengths, it suits a wide range of preferences. Bar Juice 5000 Nic Salts are made in the UK at a 50PG/50VG ratio, delivering strong flavour and discreet vapour while showcasing the concentrated, fruit-led profiles the brand is known for.
